summary: Reverse angle over the host's shoulder onto the guest, who delivers his parting verdict and breaks into a smile on 'You steam a good ham'.
framing: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up, eye level, static: guest head-and-chest on the left facing the host, host large in the right foreground. Background is the street: houses, hedge, blue sky with a grey-white cloud top left.

cast.costume: navy suit, white shirt, red tie, red pocket square

cast.visible: head and near shoulder; from 3776 the back of the head and shoulders only

beats.action: continues the calling pose from S49 seen from the other side: in profile facing left, head tipped back, eye rolled up, hand cupped at his mouth with the elbow raised
head 3/4 right, eyes heavy-lidded with pupils raised to the upper right (looking up past the host), closed frown
hand comes away from the mouth and opens, palm forward, in front of his chin
arm swings down and forward, open hand passing low across the front of the guest's chest, and is out of frame by 3761
pupils come down to centre, then (3761) the head turns a little toward the host and the heavy-lidded eyes settle on him
arm gone; still in profile with head tipped back and eye rolled up, mouth closed; holds
starts speaking; heavy lids, flat brows, level stare at the host, body still
head starts to come down and turn toward the guest
head level, turning away from camera; eye now on the guest

turned fully to the guest: back of the head, ear and a sliver of cheek to camera; his shoulders rise into the bottom-right of frame and shift a little left, settled by 3780. Holds this over-the-shoulder position, motionless, to the cut
blink: eyes shut on 3790-3791
eyes reopen heavy-lidded with pupils lowered (looking down, not at the host) while he keeps talking; holds
eyes close and stay shut or squeezed for several frames (3819-3824)
eyes reopen heavy-lidded, pupils back on the host
expression flips: eyes open wide and round, brows lift, head rises and moves slightly right, mouth curls into a closed smile
holds the bright wide-eyed look, leaning a little toward the host; grin opens to show teeth at 3849-3851
speaks the last line smiling, eyes wide on the host
leans in: head dips forward and to the right on a wide open-mouthed smile
head comes back up to the smiling position, still talking
closed-mouth smile, wide eyes on the host; holds to the cut

notes: The host's last word of L59 ('lights', script 3750-3758) spills over the cut; his mouth is closed from 3757. Guest lines L60 (script 3766-3840) and L61 (3850-3874): the mouth starts moving at 3763 and at 3852 respectively, with the toothy grin on 3849-3851 falling in the pause between them. Camera static confirmed on the sky and cloud (about 1 px wobble).
